answer.rationale: The competitor's aggressive entry pricing directly threatens price-sensitive SMB accounts, and memory_73 indicates targeted promotional pricing previously produced strong acquisition/revenue lift and reduced time-to-value in exactly this segment, making it the most directly relevant lever for the acute competitive threat. I also verify memory_86 (onboarding completion) since onboarding completion is independently down 4% QoQ and could be a competing or complementary explanation for softness in activation — I want to confirm whether the original onboarding experiment's gains were durable or already partially eroded, since that affects whether promotional pricing alone will suffice or whether onboarding is actually the more sustainable fix.
